SASBDB entry SASDR23  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDR23/)

Publication: A solution structure analysis reveals a bent collagen triple helix in the complement activation recognition molecule mannan-binding lectin-associated serine protease-3
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbc.2022.102799

The publisher's PDF is not kept in this folder: fetch it from the DOI above (open access,
PMC9898670). The fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDR23/ cites the sections and tables it
takes the buffer and sample conditions from.

Files (downloaded from SASBDB 2026-11-13, unmodified): experimental_data/SASDR23.dat (q in 1/A),
SASDR23_fit1_model1.pdb (PyMOL/MD atomic model, 3 chains, with hydrogens; ILE/THR/ALA/ARG/LEU/GLY/PRO/HYP residues, ACE/NH2 caps),
SASDR23_fit1.fit (CRYSOL, chi^2 0.079).
